implementation: External canonical PowerService/POWERSVC owns profile intent, R4STD configuration, typed IPC and exact perCPU workers; CPUPOWER remains the sole model/register/parameter owner. Firmware is installed default and creates no workers or parameter/enable writes.

Balanced/performance/saving use valid abstract local ranges, desired0 autonomous and optional EPP128/0/255. Saving bounds maximum by known HWP efficient/CPPC nonlinear or known nominal/guaranteed fallback; current CPPC CAP2 is an advisory abstract constraint. Unknown efficiency or invalid bounds refuse, never invent MHz or guaranteed physical savings.

Reset-only enable is a separately requested one-shot consent, never persisted as startup consent. The driver still applies its exact model/feature/package/current-CPU admission. Returning owned parameters does not claim hardware disable.

Each hard-placed compute worker waits for its placement/start gate, owns its exact CPU epoch/provider cookie/control token/revision and original baseline, and refreshes only observation while active. Commands/configuration stay on the service main task; brief cell copies never span kernel calls/waits.

Profile changes and quiesce return old requests and really join old workers before recycling frames or starting a new cohort. Normal ServiceStop requests same-CPU sensor-independent return before process exit. A task exit/join is not a hardware return; unexpected exits preserve exact resident control metadata and refuse reuse/false stopped state. Failed/uncertain/foreign/provider-changed controls never become false applied or returned receipts.

New independent fixed IPC records64/128/160 preserve all old fixed records. Initial passive reads allow generation0; mutations require full current process generation and service revision. SDK Zig/C clients use ordinary per-call handles, validate fixed records/full identities, preserve failed output and never retry mutations after timeout.

POWER.R4S uses existing SETTINGS/CONFIG/TEXT interfaces, strict keys/values/duplicates/format, verified atomic save and recovery. Nonnegative created/recovered save results are successful, separately from config_error. Stored profile intent is independent of actual supported/applied masks.

SYSINFO /POWER[:status|firmware|balanced|performance|saving|quiesce|resume|reload] and /POWERCPU:n expose intent/actual receipts; only explicit non-firmware selection accepts /ENABLE. CPU offline/online quiesces and really returns the whole service cohort first, because control membership leases are global, then resumes on actual remaining capacity.

Kernel mechanism only: a one-owner terminal transition closes new controls/registration and new non-return callbacks, pins CPU membership, cooperatively stops the service and requires zero controls and zero active callback frames. Only exact existing return callbacks pass the fence. Refusal reopens ownership without stopping APs; commit retains the fence/cohort through terminal reset.

Old raw halt/reboot/poweroff slots remain nonblocking/Cvoid and refuse held work immediately. Optional R4SYS27/1288 slot158/offset1280 system_power_transition(action,budget) supplies an explicit blocking budget capped5s, with negative refusal and unknown partial stop outcome. Terminal/Desktop use it and remain usable on refusal. Existing noreturn SDK source contracts keep their fallback behavior.
